Items.Name: Advanced
Items.Description: Device type and pass through, combining several devices into one controller, trigger dead zones, and the D-Pad from an axis.

Items.Name: Left trigger dead zone value
Items.Description: The left trigger dead zone slider's setting.

Items.Name: Right trigger dead zone value
Items.Description: The right trigger dead zone slider's setting.

Items.Name: Left Trigger Dead Zone
Items.Description: Add deadzone to the left trigger. Range is 0 to 255. Default is 0.

Items.Name: Right Trigger Dead Zone
Items.Description: Add deadzone to the right trigger. Range is 0 to 255. Default is 0.

Items.Name: Combined
Items.Description: Allow this controller to be combined into another virtual controller. 0 = OFF, 1 = ON.

Items.Name: Combined Index
Items.Description: The player that virtual controller will be mapped to. 0 = Player 1, 1 = Player 2, 2 = Player 3, 3 = Player 4.

Items.Name: Controller Type
Items.Description: Device Type. None = 0, Gamepad = 1, Wheel = 2, Stick = 3, FlightStick = 4, DancePad = 5, Guitar = 6, DrumKit = 8.

Items.Name: Pass Through
Items.Description: Bypass x360ce and send all input and vibration data directly to the system. This disables combining, mappings, deadzones, etc. for this controller. 0 = OFF, 1 = ON.

Items.Name: Forces Pass Through
Items.Description: Bypass x360ce for vibration data only. The controller still participates in mappings, deadzones, etc. 0 = OFF, 1 = ON.

Items.Name: Pass Through Index
Items.Description: The player that controller data will be passed through to or vibration will be read from. 0 = Player 1, 1 = Player 2, 2 = Player 3, 3 = Player 4.

Items.Name: D-Pad dead zone value
Items.Description: The dead zone slider's setting.

Items.Name: D-Pad offset value
Items.Description: The offset slider's setting.

Items.Description: Axis to control DPad. Disabled = 0, Enabled = 1.

Items.Description: Dead zone for axis.

Items.Name: Axis To D-Pad Offset
Items.Description: Axis to D-Pad offset.

Items.Name: Left Thumb
Items.Description: Dead zones and sensitivity of the left stick.

Items.Name: Stick axis
Items.Description: Dead zone, anti dead zone and sensitivity of one axis of a stick.

Items.Name: Right Thumb
Items.Description: Dead zones and sensitivity of the right stick.

Items.Name: Stick axis
Items.Description: Dead zone, anti dead zone and sensitivity of one axis of a stick.

Items.Name: Force Feedback
Items.Description: How the game's vibration reaches the device's motors.

Items.Name: Overall strength value
Items.Description: The overall force feedback strength slider's setting.

Items.Name: Use Force Feedback
Items.Description: Use Force Feedback. 0 = OFF, 1 = ON.

Items.Name: Swap Motor
Items.Description: Swap motor. 0 = OFF, 1 = ON.

Items.Name: FFB Type
Items.Description: Force Feedback type. 0 = Constant, 1 = Periodic Sine, 2 = Periodic Sawtooth

Items.Name: Force Percent
Items.Description: Strength of force feedback. Range is 0 to 100. Default is 100.

Items.Name: Left motor strength value
Items.Description: The left motor strength slider's setting.

Items.Name: Left motor period value
Items.Description: The left motor period slider's setting, in milliseconds.

Items.Name: Left Motor Direction
Items.Description: Left motor effect direction. -1, 0, 1.

Items.Name: Left Motor Strength
Items.Description: Left motor strength. Range is 0 to 100. Default is 100.

Items.Name: Left Motor Period
Items.Description: Left motor period at full drive, in milliseconds; it stretches as the drive falls, as the motor slows. The left motor is the low-frequency one. Range is 0 to 400. Default is 160, the measured motor played 4 times slower for a wheel.

Items.Name: Right motor strength value
Items.Description: The right motor strength slider's setting.

Items.Name: Right motor period value
Items.Description: The right motor period slider's setting, in milliseconds.

Items.Name: Right Motor Direction
Items.Description: Right motor effect direction. -1, 0, 1.

Items.Name: Right Motor Strength
Items.Description: Right motor strength. Range is 0 to 100. Default is 100.

Items.Name: Right Motor Period
Items.Description: Right motor period at full drive, in milliseconds; it stretches as the drive falls, as the motor slows. The right motor is the high-frequency one. Range is 0 to 400. Default is 64, the measured motor played 4 times slower for a wheel.

Items.Name: Start Test
Items.Description: Runs both motors at the strengths of the two motor sliders until pressed again.

Items.Name: Test resend interval
Items.Description: Milliseconds between the test strengths being sent again, so a device that stops on its own keeps running.

Items.Description: How far the stick must move before the game sees it move, in raw units.

Items.Description: Throw or suspend errors. 0 = Suspend, 1 = Throw.

Items.Description: Allow multiple controllers to be combined into a virtual controller. 0 = OFF, 1 = ON.

Items.Description: Allow only one instance of the application to run at a time. 0 = Allow multiple instances, 1 = Allow only one instance.

Items.Description: Leaves vJoy devices and the controllers this program feeds out of the devices it reads, so its output is not read back as input.
